query:
SELECT (
                SELECT ds.name
                FROM domain_status_change dsc
                JOIN domain_status ds ON ds.id = dsc.domain_status_id
                WHERE dsc.domain_id = d.id
                ORDER BY dsc.created_at DESC, dsc.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS "status!: DomainStatus"
            FROM domain d
            WHERE d.domain_uid = $1
